types.name: theme.Colors
types.doc: A scheme's colors, straight RGBA with every component in `[0, 1]` (module guide, section 5).

fields.name: background
fields.doc: The window clear.

fields.name: panel
fields.doc: Group and panel faces.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: Text, and the text field's caret.

fields.name: track
fields.doc: Knob rings, slider and meter tracks, toggle pills, the text field's face.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: A slider's filled part.

fields.name: control
fields.doc: Slider knobs, toggle thumbs, the scrollbar thumb, an unfocused field's border.

fields.name: meter
fields.doc: A meter's level.

fields.name: focus
fields.doc: A focused text field's border.

fields.name: selection
fields.doc: The selection band behind a field's text.

fields.name: lighten
fields.doc: What a hover mixes toward.

fields.name: darken
fields.doc: What a press mixes toward, after the hover.

types.name: theme.Form
types.doc: What shape the default skins give a scheme's faces (module guide, section 8): corners by role, how round the pill-shaped parts are, border and mark widths, whether controls are filled or outlined, how the selected tab is marked, and whether panels are framed.

fields.name: capsule
fields.doc: A pill-shaped part's corner as a fraction of the side the default skin halves, `[0, 0.5]`: 0.5 a capsule, 0 square.

fields.name: hairline
fields.doc: Borders and rules, logical pixels, `[0, stroke_max]`: field, number box, checkbox, dropdown, menu, tooltip, a focused disclosure or segmented bar, column header lines, framed panels.

fields.name: mark
fields.doc: Emphasis lines, logical pixels, `(0, stroke_max]`: the selected tab's underline, the tab insertion marker, the splitter's divider, the dock's drop outline.

fields.name: controls
fields.doc: Whether the default skin fills controls or outlines them (section 8).

fields.name: tab_mark
fields.doc: How the default skin marks the selected tab (section 8).

fields.name: framed
fields.doc: A `hairline` border in `colors.control` around solid panels.

types.name: theme.Form.Controls
types.doc: `filled` is the faces of steps 1 to 62; `outlined` draws a control as its border in the control's ink over a tint that shows only on hover and press.

types.name: theme.Form.Radii
types.doc: Corner radii by role, logical pixels, `[0, radius_max]`.

fields.name: control
fields.doc: Faces pressed or typed in: text field, number box, checkbox box, tab, a tab's close band, disclosure header, scroll thumb.

fields.name: popup
fields.doc: Popups and what opens them: menu face, dropdown face (it matches its list), tooltip, and the glass look of all three.

fields.name: band
fields.doc: Highlight bands: menu row, list and tree row, menu bar title, dock drop overlay.

types.name: theme.Form.TabMark
types.doc: `underline` is a `mark`-high line in `accents[0]` under the selected tab; `filled` fills the selected tab in `accents[0]`.

types.name: theme.Material
types.doc: What panels and popups are made of (module guide, section 7): solid faces, or glass over a backdrop (`draw/backdrop.zig`).

fields.name: blur
fields.doc: The backdrop's blur, sigma in logical pixels, `[0, blur_max]`.

fields.name: frost
fields.doc: `[0, 1]`: 0 shows the lightly filtered backdrop, 1 the blurred one.

fields.name: tint
fields.doc: `[0, 1]`: how far the backdrop moves toward the tint colour.

fields.name: saturation
fields.doc: `[0, 2]`: 1 keeps the backdrop's colours, more makes them vivid.

fields.name: rim
fields.doc: `[0, 1]`: the lit edge.

fields.name: refraction
fields.doc: How far the edge bends what is under it, logical pixels, `[0, refraction_max]`.

types.name: theme.Material.Kind
types.doc: `solid` is the faces of steps 1 to 39 (`opaque` is a Zig keyword).

fields.name: accents
fields.doc: Per-knob accent colors, cycled by index (`widgets.kit.accent`).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Control names beside a ring, meter, or pill.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Knob value readouts.

fields.name: hover_lighten
fields.doc: Shader mix toward `colors.lighten` at hover animator value 1, `[0, 1]`.

fields.name: down_darken
fields.doc: Shader mix toward `colors.darken` at press animator value 1, `[0, 1]`.

fields.name: material
fields.doc: What panels and popups are made of (section 7); a panel or menu may override it.

fields.name: form
fields.doc: What shape the default skins give faces (section 8).

types.name: theme.Theme
types.doc: The GPU record of a scheme.

fields.name: background
fields.doc: The window clear: every pass that clears the screen, and the clear pipeline.

constants.name: theme.accent_count
constants.doc: Number of accents a scheme carries; `widgets.accent_count` equals it.

constants.name: theme.arc_start
constants.doc: Start angle of the open ring, in the angle convention of the module guide.

constants.name: theme.arc_sweep
constants.doc: Clockwise sweep of the full open ring.

constants.name: theme.blur_max
constants.doc: The widest backdrop blur a material may ask for, sigma in logical pixels.

constants.name: theme.refraction_max
constants.doc: The most refraction a material may ask for, logical pixels.

constants.name: theme.radius_max
constants.doc: The widest corner a form may ask for, logical pixels (a `draw.Box` clamps its corner to half the short side).

constants.name: theme.stroke_max
constants.doc: The widest border or mark a form may ask for, logical pixels (under `widgets.splitter_px`).

constants.name: theme.dark
constants.doc: The look of steps 1 to 30, and the default `App.config.theme`.

constants.name: theme.light
constants.doc: The light counterpart of `dark`: light faces, dark text, accents a little darker, and gentler hover and press weights.

constants.name: theme.chrome
constants.doc: `dark.record()`: the record the library uploaded before schemes, for consumers that read it.

functions.name: theme.color_valid
functions.doc: True when every component of `color` is in `[0, 1]`.

functions.name: theme.problem
functions.doc: Null when every color of `scheme` is in `[0, 1]`, both weights are, and both text sizes are in `(0, text.size_max]`; otherwise a message naming the first field that is not, relative to the scheme (`colors.panel`, `accents[2]`, `name.size`).
